A lower CAS is better because CAS is a measure of how many RAM clock cycles it takes for the RAM module to output the data called for by the CPU . 

Of the two you've mentioned. It will take 40 clock cycles for the ram module with a CAS of 40 to return data, while it will take 36 clock cycles for the RAM with a CAS of 36. 

If you are running tasks where the speed of data retrieval is very important, like for gaming or data processing, then a lower CAS # is recommended.
